verdict.rationale: Wise docs show card-level controls: toggling spending permissions such as e-commerce, ATM, contactless and magnetic stripe (wise-docs-30), and spend-control rules based on MCC or transaction currency (wise-docs-32), on cards issued through the API (wise-docs-4, wise-docs-14). However, these are Platform API capabilities aimed at partners' customers, not a documented Wise Business finance-lead workflow for employee cards, and per-card monetary spend limits are not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit per-card spend-limit amounts, employee/team card management in Wise Business, a non-API admin UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
